title: RIFF block has alignment padding after odd bytes of data
summary: Data for regular RIFF subchunks is two-byte aligned, with odd lengths spanning a padding byte, and the chunk's size field does not contain this padding.
detail: A block of length 5 has an 8-byte header, and the next block starts at the beginning of the current block plus 14.
boundary: There can be optional metadata blocks in WAVE; all PCM data cannot be located with a fixed 44-byte header offset.
relevance: When parsing annotated audio attachments, avoid mistaking padding for the first byte of the next chunk name.
